title: 第 26 章 这怎么可能
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
“陈默你死定了。”

    陆云大喝一声之后一掌拍出，他对自己这一掌很有信心。

    上品法术加上金丹大圆满的修为就算是同级别的对手也未必接得住，更何况一个金丹初期的陈默。

    高台之上大长老看到陆云出手之后嘴角微微上扬，他的眼中闪过一丝阴狠的笑意。

    在心里想着这个不知天高地厚的小子终于要付出代价了，一个外门弟子也敢动他的徒弟真是不知死活。

    今天在宗门大典上当着所有人的面被陆云打成废物，看他以后还有什么脸面在青云宗待下去。

    紧接着大长老端起茶杯喝了一口然后放下，脸上的表情格外的轻松仿佛已经看到了陈默被打倒在地的画面。

    这时林凤瑶站在人群中看着擂台上的陈默，她的手不自觉地握紧了衣角。

    刚刚陆云这一掌的威力确实很强，上品法术加上金丹大圆满的修为就算是她也未必能轻松接下来。

    也不知道陈默能接住吗，想到此处林凤瑶的眉头紧锁心中充满了担忧。

    因此她在心里想着陈默可千万不能输，他要是输了被陆云打成重伤那她这个炉鼎就没了。

    上哪再去找一个像陈默这样一个炉鼎，林凤瑶咬了咬嘴唇目光紧紧盯着擂台。

    台下的陆瑶看到陆云出手之后脸上露出了灿烂的笑容，她转过头看着旁边的周玄眼中全是得意。

    “看到了吗周玄，你那个废物兄弟马上就要被我哥打残了。”陆瑶说道。

    然而周玄没有说话只是盯着擂台，他的脸色很白额头上全是汗。

    “我劝你现在赶紧想想待会儿怎么给他收尸吧。”陆瑶继续说道。

    “不过我劝你最好离他远点，免得被我哥误伤了到时候连你一起打。”

    “陈默不会输的。”周玄说道。

    当陆瑶听到这话之后愣了一下，然后哈哈大笑起来笑声里充满了嘲讽。

    “不会输你在开什么玩笑。”陆瑶说道。

    “你那个废物兄弟能打得过我哥，上次不过是侥幸赢了一次而已。”

    “这次我哥有上品法术在手你觉得他还有机会吗。”

    “你要是不信就睁大眼睛好好看看，看看你那个废物兄弟是怎么被我哥打趴下的。”

    此时的周玄咬着牙没有说话，他在心里想着陈默你一定要赢啊上次你能打赢陆云这次也一定可以的。

    这会的手心全是汗而且他的心也提到了嗓子眼。

    就在这时周围忽然传来一阵惊呼声，那声音很大带着震惊的情绪。

    “我是不是看错了，陆师兄怎么倒下了。”

    当陆瑶听到这些声音之后愣了一下，她在心里想着怎么回事这些人都在叫什么。

    “什么情况。”陆瑶喃喃自语的说道，随后抬起头朝擂台看去然后整个人都愣住了。
content_en:
"Chen Mo, you are dead."

    Lu Yun shouted loudly and then slapped his palm. He was very confident in his palm.

    Even opponents of the same level may not be able to catch the high-grade spells coupled with the golden elixir's perfect cultivation, let alone Chen Mo who is in the early stage of the golden elixir.

    The elder on the high platform slightly raised the corners of his mouth after seeing Lu Yun take action, and a sinister smile flashed in his eyes.

    I thought in my heart that this ignorant boy would finally have to pay the price. It was really reckless for an outer disciple to dare to touch his disciple.

    Today at the sect's grand ceremony, Lu Yun was beaten into pieces by Lu Yun in front of everyone. Let's see how much face he will have to stay in Qingyun Sect in the future.

    Then the great elder picked up the tea cup, took a sip and then put it down. The expression on his face was particularly relaxed, as if he had seen Chen Mo being knocked to the ground.

    At this time, Lin Fengyao stood in the crowd and looked at Chen Mo on the ring. Her hands unconsciously clenched the corners of her clothes.

    The power of Lu Yun's palm just now was indeed very powerful. With the high-grade spell and the cultivation of Jindan Dzogchen, even she might not be able to follow it easily.

    I don't know if Chen Mo can catch it. Thinking of this, Lin Fengyao's brows furrowed and her heart was filled with worry.

    Therefore, she thought in her heart that Chen Mo must not lose. If he loses and is seriously injured by Lu Yun, then she will be gone.

    Where can I find another furnace like Chen Mo? Lin Fengyao bit her lips and stared at the ring.

    Lu Yao in the audience had a bright smile on her face after seeing Lu Yun take action. She turned her head and looked at Zhou Xuan next to her with pride in her eyes.

    "Did you see Zhou Xuan? Your good-for-nothing brother is about to be crippled by my brother." Lu Yao said.

    However, Zhou Xuan didn't say anything and just stared at the ring. His face was pale and his forehead was covered with sweat.

    "I advise you to quickly think about how to collect his body later." Lu Yao continued.

    "But I advise you to stay away from him, lest my brother accidentally hurts you and beats you too."

    "Chen Mo will not lose." Zhou Xuan said.

    When Lu Yao heard this, she was stunned for a moment, and then burst into laughter. The laughter was full of ridicule.

    "I won't lose. Are you kidding me?" Lu Yao said.

    "That good-for-nothing brother of yours can beat my brother. He just won by luck last time."

    "This time my brother has a high-quality spell at his disposal. Do you think he still has a chance?"

    "If you don't believe it, just open your eyes and take a closer look, and see how your good-for-nothing brother was beaten to the ground by my brother."

    At this time, Zhou Xuan gritted his teeth and said nothing. He was thinking in his heart, Chen Mo, you must win. If you were able to defeat Lu Yun last time, you can definitely do it this time.

    His palms were now sweaty and his heart was in his throat.

    At this moment, there was a sudden exclamation from the surroundings. The sound was loud and full of shock.

    "Did I see it wrong? Why did Senior Brother Lu fall?"

    Lu Yao was stunned for a moment when she heard these voices. She was thinking about what was going on and what these people were calling.

    "What's going on?" Lu Yao murmured to herself, then raised her head and looked towards the ring and was stunned.
